name: Claw Key
summary: Within the Talon Den on Stonetalon Peak, three druidic keys guard an enchanted hoard.

sections.title: Wards of the Talon Den
sections.body: Night elf druids built the Talon Den high on Stonetalon Peak as a sanctuary and storehouse for powerful relics. They hid its treasures behind several layers of protection. Three enchanted locks seal the hoard: the Barrow Key, the Sleepers' Key, and the Claw Key. Each key rests in a druidic cache shaped like a torch, hidden in the barrow den's winding tunnels.

sections.title: Breaching the Caches
sections.body: The druids kept the keys guarded and hard to reach. Near the barrow entrance, the Gatekeeper's Key opens the cache that holds the Claw Key. The Claw Key helps break the druids' seal and reach the riches hidden deep within the mountain.

faq.q: What is the Claw Key used for?
faq.answer: The Claw Key is one of three keys needed to unlock the Talon Den Hoard, a warded stone chest in the heart of the Talon Den on Stonetalon Peak.

faq.q: Where can the Claw Key be found?
faq.answer: The Claw Key lies in a druid cache disguised as a torch in the Talon Den tunnels on Stonetalon Peak. You need the Gatekeeper's Key from the den entrance to open it.

faq.q: What other keys are needed alongside the Claw Key?
faq.answer: The Talon Den Hoard requires the Claw Key, the Barrow Key, and the Sleepers' Key. The druids kept each in a separate cache throughout the den.

faq.q: Why did the druids hide these keys?
faq.answer: Night elf druids built the Talon Den to keep powerful relics away from prying eyes. Keys and concealed caches helped deter intruders.

angles.text: By questioning captured night elves, the Horde can bypass the druids' ancient defenses and pillage the sacred artifacts atop Stonetalon Peak.
As a druid, you carry a key named for the famed Druids of the Claw. It reflects the sacred traditions and protective wards crafted by night elf barrow dwellers.
